faqs.question: What is a custom CMS website?
faqs.answer: A custom CMS (Content Management System) website is one you can easily update, redesign, and manage as your business grows. Unlike a static site, it allows you and your team to add, edit or delete content via a secure admin panel without needing HTML knowledge.

faqs.question: Why should I choose a custom CMS over a static website?
faqs.answer: Because a custom CMS gives you the flexibility to manage your content dynamically — update pages, add products, change layouts — without relying on a developer each time. It helps your online presence stay current as your business evolves.

faqs.question: What features does your custom CMS include?
faqs.answer: Our custom CMS includes features like: updated web-page content, unlimited page management, image galleries, product lists, graphics & animations, secure login, menu & link management, an easy HTML editor, link/index control, SEO-friendly framework, and social-media & Google Maps integration.

faqs.question: Can you help me migrate from my existing website to your CMS?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer website migration services that include transferring your content to the new CMS platform, ensuring a smooth transition for you and your team.

faqs.question: Will the CMS solution support SEO and long-term growth?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Our CMS solutions are built with SEO-friendly structures, modern templates, and scalable architecture — so your site not only looks good but also performs well and grows with your business.

faqs.question: What exactly does “website migration” involve?
faqs.answer: Website migration means transferring your site — including files, database, media, DNS settings, possibly domain or CMS — to a new server or environment. It can also involve domain changes or platform upgrades.

faqs.question: What are the main stages of a migration?
faqs.answer: Analysis & Prep — assess current site/server, gather all components to migrate. Configuration of new environment — install prerequisites, set up server or hosting environment. Data Transfer — move files, databases, media, email/data as needed. Testing & Quality Assurance — test site functionality, DNS, server configs, performance. DNS & Domain/E-mail Handling — update domain, DNS, email routing. Launch & Post-Migration Support — confirm website is working, monitor performance, handle any issues.

faqs.question: What are the advantages of using migration services instead of DIY?
faqs.answer: You avoid technical errors — expert handling helps prevent broken links, data loss, or server misconfiguration. SEO and traffic risk is minimized — structured migration can preserve search engine visibility. Faster, smoother transition with professional support for domain, DNS, email, database — less downtime. Better long-term stability and maintenance — your website ends up on a robust, properly configured hosting setup with backups and support.
